rationale: alarm is driven by the black_box-attributed status_macro, which has no timing, launch-domain, reset or event-retention model. caveats: CDC-023 should report capturing register a1 and CST-005 should report the u_status/status_macro inventory, both WARNING Unresolved. CDC-046(b) needs a multi-domain cone into the box. Only macro_clk and the unconstrained mode enter it, so CDC-046 is not expected and not credited.
mode has no input delay. alarm also feeds through to an output with no output delay. The macro is not reset by the IP.

Raw rst_n asynchronously resets every register with no local release synchroniser and no SDC reset exception; RDC-003 (WARNING Unresolved), RDC-002 (WARNING Unresolved) and RDC-013 (physical obligation) are expected if RDC rules run. The contract states only asynchronous assertion, so this is a whole-IP premise gap, not a defect of the labelled crossing.
